blocks.text: The first island I ever reached, on a borrowed elytra. End rods like frozen lightning, glass and pillars, and silence. The wings of the world are joined here.

It appears when the dragon dies for the second time, floating in the End void about 512 blocks from the central island, its top near Y 80. Players on the central island receive the Sanctum Compass, which points straight to it.

The four sanctum islands sit at the corners of a great square around the centre, a quarter turn apart. On worlds where the first three were placed before the fountain existed, they form a triangle instead, and the fountain takes the widest gap.
You will have no wings yet: take an elytra from an End City and glide out following the compass. That same elytra becomes the core of your Common Wings.

A floating island with its sanctum, mostly closed, entered from the front. At its heart, the Assembly Table, which joins harness, core and two wings into a pair. Endermen do not spawn on the sanctum islands.
